svg.title: Three VRAM ledgers
svg.desc: Lease budget, actual allocation, and device actual usage are different facts.

text.font-family: Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Never use one ledger as another. The page becomes unexplainable when they are mixed.

svg.text: Unmanaged VRAM is a diagnosis, not an automatic cleanup target.

svg.text: NO_LEASE: no lease for a container/process · UNKNOWN_PID: device usage without an attributable PID

text.font-family: Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NO_CONTAINER: only a total difference is visible · never auto-kill by default

text.font-family: Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If actual usage cannot be attributed, show “unmanaged” or “not reported”; do not invent a task owner.

text.font-family: Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lease answers “who may use it”; allocation answers “what a task reports”; device answers “what the card is doing”.
